title: Ameliorate impacts of scopoletin against vancomycin-induced intoxication in rat model through modulation of Keap1-Nrf2/HO-1 and IkappaBalpha-P65 NF-kappaB/P38 MAPK signaling pathways: Molecular study, molecular docking evidence and network pharmacology analysis.
authors: Khalaf, Marwa M; Hassan, Samar M; Sayed, Ahmed M; Abo-Youssef, Amira M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究东莨菪内酯对万古霉素肾毒性的保护作用，涉及Keap1-Nrf2和NF-kappaB信号通路及分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Nephrotoxicity is an indication for the damage of kidney-specific detoxification and excretion mechanisms by exogenous or endogenous toxicants. Exposure to vancomycin predominantly results in renal damage and losing the control of body homeostasis. Vancomycin-treated rats (200 mg/kg/once daily, for seven consecutive days, i.p.) revealed significant increase in serum pivotal kidney function, oxidative stress, and inflammatory biomarkers. Histologically, vancomycin showed diffuse acute tubular necrosis, denudation of epithelium and infiltration of inflammatory cells in the lining tubular epithelium in cortical portion. In the existing study, the conservative consequences of scopoletin against vancomycin nephrotoxicity was investigated centering on its capacity to alleviate oxidative strain and inflammation through streamlining nuclear factor (erythroid-derived-2) like 2 (Nrf2)/heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) signaling and prohibiting the nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB)/mitogen-activated protein kinase (p38 MAPK) pathway. With respect to vancomycin group, scopoletin pretreatment (50 mg/kg/once daily, i.p.) efficiently reduced kidney function, oxidative stress biomarkers and inflammatory mediators. Moreover, histological and immunohistochemical examination of scopoletin-treated group showed remarkable improvement in histological structure and reduced vancomycin-induced renal expression of iNOS, NF-kappaB and p38 MAPK. In addition, scopoletin downregulated (Kelch Like ECH Associated Protein1) Keap1, P38MAPK and NF-kappaB expression levels while upregulated renal expression levels of regulatory protein (IkappaBalpha), Nrf2 and HO-1. Furthermore, molecular docking and network approach were constructed to study the prospect interaction between scopoletin and the targeted proteins that streamline oxidative stress and inflammatory pathways. The present investigations elucidated that scopoletin co-treatment with vancomycin may be a rational curative protocol for mitigation of vancomycin-induced renal intoxication.
abstract_zh: 肾毒性是外源性或内源性毒物对肾脏特异性解毒和排泄机制造成损伤的指征。暴露于万古霉素主要导致肾损伤及机体稳态控制丧失。万古霉素处理的大鼠（200 mg/kg/每日一次，连续七天，腹腔注射）显示血清关键肾功能、氧化应激和炎症生物标志物显著升高。组织学上，万古霉素表现为弥漫性急性肾小管坏死、上皮脱落以及皮质部分肾小管上皮内炎症细胞浸润。在本研究中，探讨了东莨菪内酯对万古霉素肾毒性的保护性后果，重点在于其通过调节核因子（红细胞衍生-2）样2（Nrf2）/血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）信号通路并抑制核因子κB（NF-kappaB）/丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（p38 MAPK）通路来缓解氧化应激和炎症的能力。与万古霉素组相比，东莨菪内酯预处理（50 mg/kg/每日一次，腹腔注射）有效降低了肾功能、氧化应激生物标志物和炎症介质。此外，东莨菪内酯处理组的组织学和免疫组织化学检查显示组织学结构显著改善，并减少了万古霉素诱导的肾脏iNOS、NF-kappaB和p38 MAPK表达。另外，东莨菪内酯下调了（Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1）Keap1、P38MAPK和NF-kappaB表达水平，同时上调了肾脏调节蛋白（IkappaBalpha）、Nrf2和HO-1的表达水平。此外，构建了分子对接和网络方法以研究东莨菪内酯与调节氧化应激和炎症通路的靶蛋白之间的潜在相互作用。本研究表明，东莨菪内酯与万古霉素联合治疗可能是减轻万古霉素诱导的肾中毒的合理治疗方案。
